introduction.purpose: This document specifies the functional and non-functional requirements for the Untitled App task management system, providing a complete baseline for development, testing, and implementation.

product_scope.summary: The Untitled App is a web-based task management system that allows users to create, organize, and manage personal and professional tasks through an intuitive user interface.
business_objectives: Provide users with an easy-to-use task management solution
Enable efficient creation and organization of task records
Support basic task management operations for daily use
benefits: Improved personal productivity through organized task management
Reduced cognitive load by externalizing task tracking
Accessible task management for users of all technical levels
goals: Deliver a fully functional task management application
Support basic CRUD operations for task records
Provide intuitive user experience for general public users

product_perspective.system_context: The Untitled App operates as a standalone web application delivered through modern web browsers, featuring a responsive frontend interface, RESTful API services, and persistent data storage for task management operations.

functional_requirements.title: Task Creation
functional_requirements.description: The system shall allow users to create new task records with title, description, and optional metadata fields
acceptance_criteria: Users can successfully create tasks with required fields
Task creation includes validation for required fields
New tasks are immediately visible in the task list

functional_requirements.title: Task Viewing
functional_requirements.description: The system shall display task records in an organized list with filtering and sorting capabilities
acceptance_criteria: All user tasks are visible in the main dashboard
Tasks can be filtered by status and category
Task details are accessible through click/tap actions

functional_requirements.title: Task Updates
functional_requirements.description: The system shall allow users to modify existing task records including status changes and content updates
acceptance_criteria: Task updates are saved immediately upon confirmation
Status changes are reflected in real-time
Edit history is maintained for audit purposes

description_and_priority.description: Features for categorizing, prioritizing, and managing task collections

functional_requirements.title: Task Categorization
functional_requirements.description: The system shall support categorization of tasks into user-defined groups or categories
acceptance_criteria: Users can create and manage task categories
Tasks can be assigned to multiple categories

functional_requirements.title: Task Prioritization
functional_requirements.description: The system shall allow users to set and modify task priority levels
acceptance_criteria: Tasks can be sorted by priority

performance_requirements.description: The system shall load the main task dashboard within 2 seconds under normal load conditions
Task creation and update operations shall complete within 1 second for typical task records
The application shall support concurrent access by multiple users without performance degradation

safety_requirements.description: The system shall prevent accidental loss of active project work.
safety_requirements.hazard: Loss of project inputs or artifacts

security_requirements.description: User data and task records shall be protected through appropriate authentication and authorization mechanisms
All data transmissions shall use TLS encryption for secure communication
User sessions shall be properly managed with secure token-based authentication

software_quality_attributes.description: Non-technical users should complete the intake and answer flow without training.

business_rules.description: Each task must have a unique identifier and required title field
Task status transitions shall follow defined workflow rules
User access shall be restricted to their own task records only

database_requirements.description: The database shall store task records with associated metadata including title, description, status, and timestamps
User account information shall be stored securely with appropriate encryption for sensitive data
The database shall support efficient querying and indexing for task management operations

internationalization_requirements.description: The product should support future localization without changing the API contract.
locale_rules: ISO date formatting for API payloads

legal_requirements.description: The system shall comply with data protection regulations for user privacy and data security
User data retention policies shall be clearly defined and implemented
Terms of service and privacy policy shall be accessible to all users

additional_requirements.description: The application shall be responsive and work on desktop and mobile browsers
User interface shall follow accessibility guidelines for inclusive design
System shall provide clear error messages and user feedback for all operations

introduction.purpose: This document specifies the functional and non-functional requirements for a web-based to-do application, providing a complete specification for development, testing, and implementation.

product_scope.summary: A browser-accessible task management application that enables users to create, organize, and track tasks with calendar integration, email notifications, and cloud storage capabilities.
business_objectives: Provide an intuitive task management solution for general users
Enable seamless integration with existing productivity tools
Ensure data privacy and security for personal task information
benefits: Improved personal productivity and task organization
Centralized task management across multiple platforms
Automated reminders and notifications for task completion
goals: Deliver a fully functional web-based to-do application
Support integration with calendar, email, and cloud storage services
Provide reliable notification system for task reminders
